title: Probing the Misaligned Thinking Process of Language Models
title_zh: 探测语言模型的错位思维过程
abstract_en: Large language models exhibit a growing range of misaligned behaviors such as strategic deception, sandbagging, and self-preservation. As they are increasingly deployed in high-stakes settings, it is critical to reliably detect such behaviors to ensure safe and responsible use. In this work, we propose to monitor misalignment by decomposing it into fine-grained cognitive processes -- misalignment indicators -- and detecting their presence in a model's internal activations via linear probes. We develop a taxonomy of 18 indicators spanning different misaligned behaviors, paired with an automated, meta-plan-guided pipeline that generates multi-turn training conversations. To rigorously evaluate generalization, we construct an out-of-distribution suite combining automated behavioral elicitation, established misalignment benchmarks, and natural benign conversations. Across 5 misaligned behaviors, our probes match a strong LLM judge with 0.935 AUROC on out-of-distribution benchmarks while keeping a low false positive rate on benign traffic. We further perform in-depth analysis to understand the probes and the model's internal representations of misalignment indicators.
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型正表现出越来越多的错位行为（misaligned behaviors），如策略性欺骗、能力隐藏（sandbagging）和自我保护。随着其被部署到高风险场景，可靠检测这些行为对安全和负责任使用至关重要。本文提出将错位监控分解为更细粒度的认知过程——错位指标（misalignment indicators），并通过线性探针（linear probes）在模型内部激活中检测这些指标。作者构建了包含 18 个指标的分类体系，覆盖多类错位行为，并设计了一个由元计划（meta-plan）引导的自动化流程，用于生成多轮训练对话。为严格评估泛化能力，论文构建了分布外测试套件，结合自动行为诱导、已有错位基准和自然良性对话。在 5 类错位行为上，探针在分布外基准中达到 0.935 AUROC，表现接近强 LLM judge，同时在良性流量上保持较低误报率。论文还进一步分析了探针机制及模型内部对错位指标的表征方式。
key_points_zh: 提出将 misalignment 拆解为 18 个细粒度 misalignment indicators，用于刻画策略性欺骗、sandbagging、自我保护等行为背后的认知过程。
使用 linear probes 直接检测模型内部 activations 中是否存在这些错位指标，而不只依赖外部文本行为判断。
设计 meta-plan-guided 自动化数据生成流程，构造多轮训练对话以训练探针。
构建分布外评估套件，结合自动行为诱导、已有 misalignment benchmarks 和自然 benign conversations，检验泛化与误报率。
在 5 类错位行为上达到 0.935 AUROC，接近强 LLM judge，并在良性流量上保持低 false positive rate。

llm_assessment.comment: Interesting model-safety probing work, but it is mostly generic misalignment detection rather than agent-runtime governance infrastructure.
